stem.text: What could happen to a typical bacterium when it is placed in surroundings which have a less negative water potential than that inside the cell?

A.text: The bacterium will burst because the cell wall has no structural function.

B.text: The bacterium will die since water leaves the cell by osmosis.

C.text: There is no change because the cell wall is impermeable to water.

D.text: There will be a net movement of water into the bacterium.
